messages:
Noah: quick heads-up: we hit a regression where Hosted silently downgraded to a slower kernel because adapters exposed inconsistent manifest keys.
Priya: example?
Noah: logs show Dedicated sent `quantization: q4_0` in body, but the shim normalized it to `quant-q4_0` so runtime didn't match the preferred kernel.
Diego: that's why we need a strict manifest schema and a small compatibility handshake.
Sam: proposal: require manifest_version (major int), capabilities as array of objects {name,version,attrs} and a capability_hash header for fast comparison. Add top-level fallback_policy.
Priya: privacy: Private deployments should be able to set expose_level: none|hash_only|full. Default hash_only. If none, Hosted can only rely on policy flags (failover_allowed=false by default).
Noah: also errors: adapters must wrap runtime errors in an envelope {source_mode,error_code,retry_hint,safe_message} or publish header X-RW-ADAPTER-ERR to avoid leaking node ids. If missing, Hosted falls back to heuristics and emits upgrade telemetry.
Diego: streaming case: emit a final ERROR_ENVELOPE frame rather than raw traces.
Sam: rollout: 1) publish schema v2 draft 2) land shim that accepts v1/v2 and emits headers 3) enable linting 4) opt-in enforcement 5) full enforcement after 2 sprints.
PatchBot: infra: manifest-schema-v2 draft uploaded, linter rule added, canary rollout scheduled.
Priya: tests: handshake unit tests, e2e hosted->dedicated matrix, privacy knob checks, and telemetry for missing envelopes.
Noah: sounds good. I'll draft an RFC with schemas, header examples, migration checklist, and alert thresholds. Ping owners for review.
Sam: please call out exact telemetry metric names and the alerting thresholds in the RFC.
Diego: I'll draft the shim change for header emission and streaming frame handling.
Priya: I'll own the privacy doc and the expose_level semantics.
Noah: thanks all, tracking issue incoming.
